FIRST ADDENDUM 
 to Agreement to Sell by and between 
 Deevar Developers (Private) Limited (referred to as “Developer” ) and [•] [Buyer/Buyers Names] (individually, or in the case of joint buyers and collectively referred to as “Buyer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This first a ddendum (“ First A ddendum ”) to the Agreement to Sell [Serial No.] dated [•] [INSERT DATE], (“ Agreement to Sell ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [•], 202 3 (“ Effective Date ”). 
 WHEREAS 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement to Sell for the sale and purchase of a residential apartment bearing Unit No. [●] measuring [ ●] located at Zameen Opal, Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Unit ”); 
 The Developer had notified to the Buyer through a Letter of Intimation of Zameen Opal dated [•] [DATED] about the continued surge in prices of Component Materials which has prompted an adjustment in the Purchase Price to the extent of the Adjusted Amount under Clause 3.3 and the Buyer has acknowledged and agreed to such adjustment; 
 The construction of the Unit has been completed and the Completion Notice dated [●] (the “ Completion Notice ”) has been sent to the Buyer to take over possession of the Purchased Unit after clearing all outstanding Instalments with respect to the Purchase Price and any other payments due on possession under the Agreement to Sell ; 
 Pursuant to the above, to facilitate buyers who have multiple Instalments remaining in the Payment Plan, t he Developer A t the request of the Buyer, the Developer has agreed offered to grant an conditional licence to occupy a Unit temporarily until such time as all remai ning Instalments, along with any other payments due under the Agreement to Sell, are paid in clear funds by the said buyer , in accordance with the to revise the Payment Plan of the Unit and grant an exclusive temporary license to occupy the Unit in favour of the Buyer, provided that the Buyer fulfils his/her obligation under the Agreement to Sell including the payments of remaining instalments under the revised Payment Plan appended to this First Addendum ; and 
 The Buyer has accepted the aforementioned offer of the Developer and, accordingly, the Parties have agreed to revise, amend and supplement the Agreement to Sell 
 P ursuant to Clause 1 5 . 2 of the Agreement , the Parties hereby mutual ly agree to revise , amend and supplement the Agreement in accordance as per with the terms and conditions hereof. 
 NOW , THEREFORE, the P arties agree as follows: 
 The First A ddendum shall be effective from the Effective Date . 
 The Payment Plan specified in Attachment B of the Agreement is hereby revised and amended with the Payment Plan specified in Attachment Annexure A appended to this First A ddendum . For the avoidance of doubt, the Payment Plan in Attachment B shall have no force or effect as of the Effective Date. Any and all references to Attachment B in the Agreement shall be deemed to be a reference to Attachment Anne xure A appended to this First A ddendum . 
 
 The Developer hereby grants to the Buyer an exclusive conditional and temporary license to occupy the Purchased Unit (the “ Licence ”) for the period of the remaining /outstanding Instalments of the Payment Plan subject to the licensing terms and conditions until the payment of last instalment/possession charges under the revised Payments Plan and subject to the terms and conditions stated in Annexure B appended to this First Addendum ( the “License Terms ” ) and payment of Service Charges Advance at the time of execution of this Addendum . 
 Under the Licence and during the Licence Period, The Developer further grants the Buyer will have the right to sub- license the Purchased Unit during the License period and the License granted under Clause 3 above shall be utilized strictly in accordance with the Licence terms terms and conditions of the License appended herewith as Attachment B to this First Addendum . 
 The Buyer agrees understands and acknowledges that the Licence is a conditional permission to occupy the Purchased Unit and Buyer only has the license to occupy the Unit and has the right sub license the Unit and th is License does not create or transfer any right s , title or interest s in the Purchased Unit in favour of the Buyer or the sub- licencee except to the extent en visaged under the Licence Terms . 
 The grant and subsistence of the Licence is strictly subject to fulfillment of the Buyer’s obligations under the Agreement to Sell , particularly payment of Instalments. T In the event the Buyer fails to fulfill his/her obligation under the Agreement to Sell including the payment of remaining instalments as per the revised Payment Plane appended to this First A ddendum , t he Developer shall be entitled to revoke the License in the event of default or failure on the part of the Buyer to fulfill her/his obligations under the Agreement to Sell . and upon revocation of the License the Buyer shall peacefully handover the vacant possession the Unit to the Developer. 
 The Parties agree that u U pon fulfillment of all obligations and payment of all Instalments and payments due under the Agreement to Sell , including inter alia Possession Amount and Adjusted Amount, by the Buyer, the Developer completion of the revised Payment Plan appended to this First Addendum, the Develop er shall transfer all rights, title and interests in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer by way of issuance of an a llotment and possession l etter . For the sake of clarity it is stated that u by issuance of an allotment letter in favour of the Buyer (“ Allotment Letter ”). U pon the issuance of the Allotment a llotment Letter l etter the temporary license granted herein shall cease to exist. 
 The Buyer agrees to furnish the following pos t dated cheques in favour of the Developer , with unconditional right to encash them, as a promise to pay in future the Instalments remaining instalments as per the P ayment P lan: 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 Rs. [●] (Rupees ●in words] via cheque number [●], dated [●], drawn on Bank [●]. 
 The scanned copy of the postdated cheque issued under this clause is attached in the Annexure [●]. 
 The Buyer further agrees and acknowledges that i I n the event any of the banker’s cheques referred to in Clause 8 aforementioned cheques is dishonored or payment is refused by the issuing bank for any reason whatsoever , in addition to any other remedy available to the Developer , the Developer shall have the right to initiate proceedings under the Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 and any other applicable laws against the Buyer , in addition to any other rights or remed ies available to the Developer . 
 Clause 5 .2 of Agreement to Sell is hereby reviewed and revised as follows: 
 “ The Developer shall issue the Completion Notice to the Buyer communicating the Completion Date and informing the Buyer to make all outstanding payments as per the payment plan, under the Agreement. ” 
 Clause 5.3 of the Agreement to Sell is hereby reviewed and revised as follows: 
 “ On the Completion Date, subject to terms of this Agreement, the Developer shall handover vacant possession of the Unit to the Buyer as per the terms and conditions of the License. Upon completion of payments under the payment plan, the Developer shall issue an a llotment l etter and shall render all reasonable assistance to the Buyer, including issuance of NOC for recording of Buyer’s rights in the Unit in the relevant department / revenue record, if requested by the Buyer. The Developer shall have the right to revoke the License and evict the Buyer from the Unit where the Buyer is not in compliance with its obligations under the Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, recording of the Buyer’s rights in the relevant department / revenue record shall be at the discretion and cost of the Buyer. ” 
 Clause 5.4 of the Agreement to Sell is hereby reviewed and revised as follows: 
 “ In the event, the Buyer fails to take over possession of the Unit as pre the terms and conditions of the License on the Completion Date, for any reason whatsoever, then all risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Completion Date, whereas rights in the Unit shall be transferred upon fulfillment of all obligations and responsibilities of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell including completion of payments as specified in the Payment Plan. In addition, the Buyer shall be obligated to pay a monthly fee for each month he fails to take possession ” 
 
 For the avoidance of doubt, notwithstanding anything contained herein or in the Agreement to Sell, the Buyer shall be liable for all risk and costs applicable to the Purchased Unit as and from the Completion Date (including loss of or damage to the Unit or any part thereof). 
 The Developer shall obtain and, to the extent possible, assign to the Buyer the benefit of any manufacturers’ warranties, in respect of any fixtures or fittings installed by or on behalf of the Developer in the Purchased Unit on and from the Completion Date . The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty as regards the fitness for use or quality of appliances, fittings or fixtures and has relied on the manufacturers'/suppliers' representations and warranties in this regard. The maintenance and/or replacement of all appliances in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers issued at the time of purchase of such appliances and the Developer shall have no liability thereof including any extension in the warranty periods of such warranties. 
 Except to the extent specified herein, any other obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell to be completed on or before the Completion Date are hereby extended until the Licence Period lapses or the Licence is revoked/terminated. 
 It is clarified that , as per Clause 5.4 of the Agreement to Sell, a ll risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Completion Date, whereas rights in the Unit shall be transferred with actual possession , i.e. upon payment of all Instalments and fulfilment of all obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell . 
 This First A ddendum shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis, and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the First A ddendum shall prevail, and any conflicting term (s) in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this First A ddendum , unless otherwise specified. 
 The First A ddendum may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same addendum . 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Addendum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses .
